intro: Arkansas Legislative Audit examines every county and publishes what it finds. This page quotes what the auditors reported about Union County, from its latest report — no verdict added in either direction. What the auditors said is the record; what to make of it is yours.
regulatory_basis_note: Read this before reading any Arkansas audit: county and city reports carry a technical 'adverse opinion' on GAAP grounds because Arkansas law has them keep books on a simpler 'regulatory basis.' That phrase appears in every such audit in the state and signals the accounting format — not wrongdoing. A report is 'clean' or not in its findings, deficiencies, and noncompliance sections, which is what this page quotes.

verdicts.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of County Judge and County Clerk. Const. art 12, § 5, as interpreted by Op. Att'y Gen.
verdicts.detail: A limited review (a “financial and compliance report”), not a full audit: the financial statements in it are unaudited. The letter continues in the report on page 3; parts that concern staff positions are left to the report, since this site doesn’t single out non-elected staff.

limits: From the 2024 report, dated May 28, 2026. Read by machine from the report’s text; the quotes are the auditors’ words. Older reports, and the separate federal (single) audits, aren’t on this page yet.
Arkansas alternates between full audits and limited “financial and compliance” reviews; each line says which this is.

cities.name: Felsenthal
cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of Mayor and Recorder/Treasurer. Recorder/Treasurer In 2024, the Recorder/Treasurer paid herself $1,778 in excess of appropriated salary without supporting documentation, in noncompliance with Ark. Code Ann. § 14-42-120.

cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of Mayor and Chief Financial Officer. Leave records were not maintained so we were unable to verify the validity of the payment. Subsequently, she received a $700 bonus that was not appropriated for her elected position.
